content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Gorakhpur
content_sections.text: The All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Gorakhpur, in Uttar Pradesh, describes itself as an autonomous organisation under the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India. These posts belong to ongoing extramural projects funded by the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR). The Principal Investigator is Dr. U Venkatesh, Assistant Professor, Department of Community Medicine & Family Medicine.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Gorakhpur Project Research Scientist and Project Technical Support Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Age is counted as on the last date of application, which is 15 November 2026. Essential: Postgraduate degree in Public Health / Biostatistics & Demography / Population Studies / Geography or a relevant discipline from a recognized university, with five years of research experience in a relevant field. Desirable publications: Five original research publications in MEDLINE/PubMed-indexed journals in the relevant area. The journals should be listed in the Science Citation Index (SCI). Desirable experience: Prior experience in community-based studies. Research skills: Advanced data analysis, scientific report writing, manuscript preparation and publication, team management, and field-level data collection, monitoring and supervision. Candidates should be able to coordinate and carry out research activities independently. Leadership skills: Ability to work in a diverse interdisciplinary environment and to guide other team members. Essential: Three-year graduate degree in Public Health / Medical Social Workers (MSWs) / Sociology / Computer Application / Biostatistics or other relevant disciplines from a recognized university. Experience: Three years of post-qualification experience, or a PG in the relevant subject or field. Mandatory: Willingness and ability to travel extensively for field tasks on a regular basis. Desirable: Experience in field data collection related to Health/Population. Experience is counted from the date of completing the minimum essential educational qualification. Candidates already working against regular or permanent posts in Government departments or organisations are not eligible. Candidates employed in Government settings must submit a No Objection Certificate at the interview. Without it, they may not be allowed to appear. Age relaxation is given as per ICMR/Government of India guidelines. SC/ST/OBC relaxation applies only to posts reserved for that category, not to unreserved posts. Relaxation for Ex-servicemen and departmental candidates, including project staff, follows Government of India/ICMR norms. Check the official notification for the full post-wise eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Document verification: Only candidates found eligible here may take the interview. Written examination: This may be held before the interview if many eligible candidates turn up. Walk-in interview: Held on 16 November 2026 at 9:00 AM at the Department of Community & Family Medicine, Academic Block (MNC building), AIIMS, Gorakhpur. If there are many eligible candidates, the appointing authority may use higher criteria to shortlist candidates for the interview, written test or personal discussion. Meeting the essential qualification does not guarantee shortlisting. The decision of the Screening Committee, Interview Committee or competent authority is final.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Both positions are purely temporary and contractual and end with the project. They give no right to a regular post, absorption or transfer at AIIMS Gorakhpur, ICMR or any Government body. The first engagement runs up to 31 March 2027. It may be extended until the project ends, depending on funds, performance and approval. The engagement may be ended at any time, without notice, if performance is not satisfactory. Staff will normally work at the study or project site but may be deputed to other sites. Provident Fund, LTC, medical claims and other regular service benefits are not provided. Leave follows ICMR or project rules. Selected candidates must join within 15 days of the result or offer letter. They must also sign the declaration, code of conduct and confidentiality undertaking. The engagement follows the ICMR Extramural Research Grant guidelines.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Gorakhpur Project Research Scientist and Project Technical Support Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill the online application form at the AIIMS Gorakhpur application form by 15 November 2026, 5:00 PM. Submit a separate application for each position you want to apply for. Fill every column and write "N/A" where you have nothing to enter. Your name, parents' names and date of birth must match your Matriculation certificate. Print and keep a copy of the submitted form. Report at the Department of Community & Family Medicine, Academic Block (MNC building), AIIMS, Gorakhpur, on 16 November 2026 at 9:00 AM. Incomplete, late, unsigned applications, or those without a recent photograph or the required documents, will be rejected. Requests to change the interview date will not be accepted. Filled application form (printed copy), a detailed bio-data/CV and two recent passport-size colour photographs Photo identity and address proof: Aadhar card, Driving Licence, Voter ID card, PAN card or Passport Proof of date of birth: 10th certificate or birth certificate Category certificate (for OBC, a non-creamy layer certificate issued within the last one year) 10th and 12th marksheets and certificates, and the qualifying degree Experience certificate showing the dates of joining and relieving List of publications with one original copy, and GATE/NET certificate (if any) No Objection Certificate, if you are employed in a Government setting Bring one set of self-attested photocopies as well. The institute has no photocopy facility. No TA/DA is paid for attending.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts has AIIMS Gorakhpur advertised in this notice?
faq.answer: There are 2 posts: one Project Research Scientist-III (Non-Medical) and one Project Technical Support-III.

faq.question: Q2. Is filling the online form enough, or must I attend the interview too?
faq.answer: You need to do both. Submit the Google Form by 5:00 PM on 15 November 2026, then report at the venue on 16 November 2026 at 9:00 AM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the pay for the Project Research Scientist-III post?
faq.answer: It is Rs. 78,000 plus 20% HRA, which comes to Rs. 93,600 a month.

faq.question: Q4. What is the pay for the Project Technical Support-III post?
faq.answer: It is Rs. 28,000 plus 20% HRA, which comes to Rs. 33,600 a month.

faq.question: Q5. Can a postgraduate apply for Project Technical Support-III without three years of experience?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice accepts either three years of post-qualification experience or a PG in the relevant subject or field, along with the three-year graduate degree.

faq.question: Q6. On which date is my age counted?
faq.answer: Age is counted as on the last date of application, 15 November 2026. The upper limit is 45 years for the Scientist post and 35 years for the Technical Support post.

faq.question: Q7. Will there be a written test?
faq.answer: A written examination may be held before the interview if the number of eligible candidates is large.

faq.question: Q8. How long will the job last?
faq.answer: The first engagement runs up to 31 March 2027. It may be extended until the project ends, subject to funds and performance.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply if I already hold a permanent Government job?
faq.answer: No. Candidates working against regular or permanent Government posts are not eligible. Other Government employees must bring a No Objection Certificate.

faq.question: Q10. Will travel expenses for the interview be paid?
faq.answer: No TA/DA is paid. Candidates must arrange their own travel and accommodation.
